narr: A warm front lifted northward off the Gulf Coast, causing rapid moisture transport to the Mid-South. In addition, an upper-level trough and associated cold front approached the area. This led to showers in the afternoon and then severe thunderstorms that continued through the overnight hours. Damaging wind, hail, tornadoes, and flash flooding were the result.
ev: County Road 450 was washed out just east of County Road 461.
Highway 79 was closed in both directions in Marianna.
Residential flooding occurred on Formon Drive and Stacy Drive in north Paragould. Water reached at least 6 inches deep in some homes and some residents were evacuated.
Numerous units were flooded at an apartment complex near South Avalon Steet and River Road.
